prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE flat children’s educational illustration, crisp shapes and simple solid colors. CACE N6: RUC + NETEJAR + BICICLETA + AMB + MOCADOR. Semantic focus: instrument. NO HUMAN FIGURES. Exact scene: RUC: El mocador de tela frega fang del quadre d’una bicicleta estable; plecs visibles, bicicleta completa i cap esponja. Animal o criatura antropomòrfica amable; potes, ales o trompa adaptades al gest, amb anatomia recognoscible. L’eina actua sobre l’objecte; no està simplement al costat. Fons blanc sense escenari de lloc recognoscible; només base de suport imprescindible. Pure white seamless background. WIDE SHOT, camera far away: entire people or animals INCLUDING FEET, every target object and ALL furniture legs fully in frame. Scale the complete composition small to fit the CENTRAL 65 percent of the canvas; leave a WHITE BORDER at least 12 percent wide on ALL FOUR sides. Never crop lower legs or desk legs. One action in one instant, no sequence or collage. Only essential support. Friendly school material. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, brands, logos, watermark, arrows or speech bubbles, including clothing and books. Humans wear ordinary clothes. Hands/paws make clear functional contact. No identifiable room or landscape. Exactly the named living participants, no spectators, no family group, no additional people or animals. Vary human skin and hair naturally: medium brown skin, curly black hair. Do not add plants, carpets or decorative accessories not required by the scene. CORRECTION REQUIRED: NO HUMANS. The ONLY living participant is a grey DONKEY (Catalan RUC) with very long upright ears, equine muzzle, short mane, hooves and a thin tufted tail. Upright on two hind legs, using two forelegs as arms, FOUR limbs total. Donkey cleans whole bicycle with a small thin soft HANDKERCHIEF (MOCADOR), folded light blue flexible cotton cloth clearly touching dirty frame. NO sponge. No room, white background and wide margins. Exactly the target living participants only. No bystanders or extra family. Include feet, full furniture legs and all objects, scale the whole composition to the central 65 percent, leave at least a 12 percent empty white border on all FOUR sides. Wide distant view, never crop.
